summary: The focused array printing claim is refuted: arrays accepted by parsing remain below the new printing depth limit.

assessment.necessity_reason: For claim o-bb75d53a17ee2a91 (g0001), the harness prints parser-produced trees. Parsing rejects arrays and objects when their nesting depth reaches CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT, so an accepted array does not reach the new print rejection condition.

before.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at a nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting its depth.
before.reason: The old array printer has no depth rejection, and the harness passes parsed trees to its print calls.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array parsing checks and increments nesting depth.
Object parsing applies the same limit to mixed nesting.
Unbuffered printing initializes depth to zero and dispatches the tree to print_value.
Buffered printing also initializes depth to zero before dispatch.

after.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at a nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting its depth.
after.reason: The new array print check rejects depth at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT, which array and object parsing already reject. Both print paths start at depth zero.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array parsing rejects a container at the same nesting threshold.
Object parsing enforces the same threshold for mixed nesting.
Unbuffered printing initializes depth to zero and dispatches the tree.
Buffered printing also initializes depth to zero before dispatch.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same old harness satisfies the frozen array depth obligation on both sides. The focused assessment does not establish coverage of other obligations.
